system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: saas-postgres-instance
  type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:instances
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    databaseVersion: POSTGRES_15
    settings:
      tier: db-custom-2-7680
      backupConfiguration:
        enabled: true
        startTime: "02:00"
        pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      ipConfiguration:
        ipv4Enabled: true
        authorizedNetworks:
        - name: default
          value: 0.0.0.0/0
      locationPreference:
        zone: us-central1-a
      dataDiskType: PD_SSD
      dataDiskSizeGb: 50
      maintenanceWindow:
        day: 7
        hour: 3
        updateTrack: stable
      databaseFlags:
      - name: log_checkpoints
        value: 'on'
      - name: log_connections
        value: 'on'
      - name: log_disconnections
        value: 'on'
      - name: log_lock_waits
        value: 'on'
      - name: log_min_messages
        value: 'warning'
      - name: log_temp_files
        value: '0'
      storageAutoResize: true
      storageAutoResizeLimit: 500
      activationPolicy: ALWAYS
      availabilityType: ZONAL
      insightsConfig:
        queryInsightsEnabled: true
        queryPlansPerMinute: 5
        queryStringLength: 1024
        recordApplicationTags: true
        recordClientAddress: true
    rootPassword: $(ref.saas-postgres-password.password)
    
- name: saas-postgres-password
  type: gcp-types/secretmanager-v1:projects.secrets
  properties:
    projectId: {{ env["project"] }}
    secretId: saas-postgres-root-password
    replication:
      automatic: {}
      
- name: saas-postgres-password-version
  type: gcp-types/secretmanager-v1:projects.secrets.versions
  properties:
    projectId: {{ env["project"] }}
    secretId: saas-postgres-root-password
    payload:
      stringData: {{ properties["rootPassword"] | default("GENERATE_RANDOM_PASSWORD") }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - saas-postgres-password
    
- name: saas-database
  type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:databases
  properties:
    instance: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.name)
    name: saas_application
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - saas-postgres-instance

outputs:
- name: instanceConnectionName
  value: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.connectionName)
- name: instanceIp
  value: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.ipAddresses[0].ipAddress)
- name: databaseName
  value: saas_application
- name: secretName
  value: saas-postgres-root-password
